diagnosis: Checks C2 and C4 are leaking because they rely on boolean or default values that the model can satisfy without the hidden information. Specifically, C2 (linked to PF1) passes because the model defaults to appointing 'Mara' as the cohort lead based on shared facts, even though it lacks the facilitation evidence required by PF1. C4 (linked to PF2) passes because the model defaults 'friday_sessions_allowed' to false, which happens to match the prohibited status dictated by PF2.

fix_instructions: Tighten C2 by requiring the model to explicitly set 'readiness_evidence_recorded' to true only if PF1 is known; currently, the model is passing C2 while setting this to false. Tighten C4 by requiring a specific numeric value for 'weekly_lead_hours' (3) that cannot be guessed via a default of 0, ensuring the check fails unless PF2 is accessed.
